suggestions.pitch: Joe Mixon projects 15.3 a week as a clear RB starter for me, and I give up two bench-level players, adding about 42 points.
Rodgers fills my superflex slot far better than Prescott, and the 0-6 partner gets a younger RB for two aging QBs.
Trey Benson sits on my bench projecting almost nothing, and Tua plus Kupp add real starting production at a high acceptance chance.
